section.title: Risks / problems / uncertainties
section.p: Carried unchanged from the drafted dashboard (`2026-10-07-22-15-rlmresearch-drafted-plan.xml`): deep-research cost/availability (fallback: manual fan-out as deviation), link rot/paywalls (snapshot at first touch), license surprises (harmless: inspiration-only regardless), volume blowout (tiers absorb; floor = every source has a verdict), arXiv id sanity check at Ф3, Glob unreliability (PowerShell listings), delegate cwd law (pin cwd in every launch).
